quit.title: Discard unsaved changes?
quit.text: Your draft has not been applied. Confirm to discard it and exit.
cancel.title: Discard draft?
cancel.text: This returns to the main menu. The firewall is unchanged.
language.title: Select your language / Выберите язык
welcome.title: Welcome to GeoLatch
welcome.text:
Block new incoming connections from selected countries on specific server IP addresses. Existing firewall rules remain in effect.

The setup prepares a draft. Rules change only after your final confirmation.
interfaces.title: Select incoming network interfaces
interfaces.text: Select only interfaces receiving traffic to protect. Loopback, bridges and VPN tunnels require particular care. Space toggles a checkbox.
interfaces.empty: No network interfaces found. Check iproute2 and run Diagnostics.
interfaces.required: Select at least one incoming interface.
destinations.title: Select destination IP addresses
destinations.text: Filtering applies only to selected server addresses on selected interfaces. “All” resolves current public local addresses when rules are applied.
destinations.all: All public local addresses on selected interfaces
destinations.warning: A manually entered address must belong to this server or be routed to it before DNAT. Check this yourself before applying.
destinations.invalid: Enter a valid unicast IPv4 or IPv6 address.
destinations.required: Select an address or the all-addresses mode.
countries.title: Select countries to block
countries.text: Search by country name or ISO code. Multiple policies on one destination combine their blocked countries. GeoIP is approximate.
families.title: IP address families
families.text: Choose families matching the destination addresses. IPv6 is optional when unavailable.
families.unavailable: No discovered address uses this family. Explicit routed addresses may still be configured.
provider.title: GeoIP data source
provider.text: Sources are free and downloaded over HTTPS. The compact RIR database can differ in accuracy and coverage. Sources never switch automatically after a failure.
provider.rir: ipverse Country IP Blocks — compact RIR data
allowlist.title: Protect administrative access
allowlist.text:
Enter trusted administrator IPs or CIDRs, one per line. They bypass only GeoLatch restrictions. Your SSH peer may be a proxy or VPN, so verify the actual address.

Every manual apply starts an independent rollback watchdog. Confirm only after checking a new SSH connection.
allowlist.placeholder: IP or CIDR, separated by spaces or commas
policies.title: Policies
policies.text: Each policy pairs destination IPs with blocked countries. Overlapping policies combine restrictions. Disabled policies do not filter traffic.
policy.title: Policy: {name}
policy.delete.title: Delete this policy?
policy.delete.text: The policy will be removed from the draft. Apply the draft to change the firewall.
policy.name: Policy name
policy.name.invalid: Use 1–64 ASCII letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores; start with a letter or number. Names must be unique.
settings.title: Settings
updates.title: Automatic GeoIP updates
established.title: Existing connections
established.text: Preserving established and related connections reduces SSH lockout risk. Turning this off also filters established original-direction traffic; replies to outbound connections are preserved.
review.title: Review changes before applying
review.text: Only GeoLatch objects are modified. A timed rollback protects manual changes. Check a new SSH connection before confirming. No configuration has been applied yet.
progress.title: Applying protection
progress.text: Downloading and validating required GeoIP data, preparing an atomic nftables transaction and checking the actual firewall state. Please wait.
confirm.title: Verify access and confirm
confirm.text: Rules are applied temporarily. Open a NEW SSH connection, verify access, then confirm here. The independent watchdog restores the previous state if you do not confirm.
confirm.expired: The confirmation period expired. The watchdog is restoring the previous state; check Diagnostics for the result.
completed.title: Configuration confirmed
completed.text: GeoLatch verified the applied rules and saved the confirmed configuration.
update.title: GeoIP updates
update.text: All required countries must validate before an update can replace the active rules. Failed updates preserve the previous confirmed state.
stats.title: Actual firewall statistics
doctor.title: System diagnostics
logs.title: Event history
disable.title: Disable GeoLatch filtering?
disable.text: Only the GeoLatch table is removed. Other firewall rules remain in effect.
rollback.title: Restore previous confirmed state?
rollback.text: This restores GeoLatch rules and configuration from the previous confirmed snapshot.
label.name: Name
value.systemd_unavailable: systemd is unavailable; automatic updates need a supported systemd installation.
value.systemd_timer_failed: The systemd update timer could not be configured. Check Diagnostics.
value.notrack_requires_review: Review any existing notrack rules: GeoLatch requires connection tracking.
value.nonstandard_hook_priorities_requir: Review nonstandard DNAT or prerouting priorities.
value.firewall_reload_can_remove_geolatc: Reloading another firewall can remove the GeoLatch table; check actual status afterwards.
recovery.draft_restored: Your interrupted configuration has been restored as a draft. Review and apply it again.
